author: ZelenskyyUa
text:
I met with @EmmanuelMacron. We spoke primarily about security and the winter support package for Ukraine. We are also ready to secure additional SAMP/T air defense systems and missiles for them using the financial resources available through the EU loan.

We continue working on the possibility of producing these air defense systems and missiles in Ukraine, as well as on the joint FREYJA anti-ballistic program with our partners. We expect to see the first results this year. We are doing everything we can to strengthen the protection of our people. Thank you, Emmanuel! Thank you, France!
